subject.title: fix(mobile): load pinned and base-path Control UI pages

question: Should this security-sensitive native WebView behavior be accepted after a direct Android/iOS runtime review, or should the SSL-error exception be narrowed further?
rationale: The implementation intentionally crosses a certificate-validation boundary and is protected with a `maintainer` label; automated review cannot safely choose the repository's acceptable native trust-policy boundary.

options.title: Approve after runtime proof
options.body: Confirm the real accepted-pin Android flow and non-root iOS base-path flow, then merge if the exact-origin and fail-closed behavior are observed.

options.title: Narrow or redesign the exception
options.body: Require a smaller trust-policy boundary if the Android platform contract shows the WebView callback can authorize a broader navigation set than intended.
